name: JS85 Magnetic Mobile Phone Cooler
description:
Model	JS85
Product Type	Magnetic Mobile Phone Cooler
Cooling Technology	Semiconductor cooling
Attachment	Magnetic suction (clip-on/magnetic)
Battery	Built-in rechargeable battery (internal)
Display	Digital display (mode/speed indicator)
Operation Modes	Multiple speeds / selectable modes
Noise	Low-noise / silent operation (speed-dependent)
Color	Black
Charging Port	USB (charging cable included)
Compatibility	Works with phones having magnetic contact area or thin cases
In the Box	Mobile phone cooler, USB charging cable
